title: Faster Base64 Encoding and Decoding Using AVX2 Instructions
key_contribution: Introduced the multiply-add packing technique for Base64, showing PMADDUBSW+PMADDWD replaces 9 shift/mask/or instructions with 2 multiply-add instructions.

title: Decoding billions of integers per second through vectorization
key_contribution: Demonstrated SIMD multiply-add for integer decoding achieving 2x speedup, establishing the pattern of using arithmetic instructions for bit manipulation.

title: A General SIMD-Based Approach to Accelerating Compression Algorithms
key_contribution: Generalized SIMD-based bit packing/unpacking for compression algorithms, providing the theoretical framework for multiply-add based field manipulation.
